title: Prove released installed guidance reaches the receiving agent
text: Source and automated HTTPS transport tests cover installed help, managed release manifests and refresh recovery. The production image correction stages canonical inputs and builds a real project bundle. Receiving QA failed: complete received context was unobservable, no-project deeper help was absent, and Cursor shell calls returned blank refusals. A diagnostic replay proved the local permission hook returned exit zero with empty stdout; same-item rework supplies native permission replies and corrects the shared context recipe to the live entries list. Native acceptance, complete combined delivery count and fixture cleanup remain unproven; file delivery and tiny diagnostic turns do not satisfy them.
